objective: Improve the reproducible R25 square-primary route by changing only polygon target rasterization from OpenCV rounded fill to COCO frPyObjects/merge/decode. Do not claim the historic submitted .37 bytes are recovered; that source identity remains incomplete.

history_review.proposal_box_alignment: R25 square training already uses a 60% HBB OOF proposal / 40% consensus-GT mix; not novel hypothesis.

single_variable: For polygon masks only, use pycocotools.frPyObjects -> merge -> decode. Candidate averages the exact same consensus_segmentations in the same order as control. RLE behavior, record/member selection, source pools, box, crop rounding, prompt, resize, augmentation, loss and inference are held fixed.

arms.candidate: same six-epoch continuation, only COCO polygon rasterizer changed

frozen_original_fullroute_coco_baseline.old_report_metric_not_comparable: Original validation used cv2 polygon GT decoding; this is separately rescored COCO baseline.

validation.comparison: candidate vs matched cv2 continuation and frozen original R25 full-route masks rescored with COCO
validation.exposure: R25 validation was reused. R22 has 141 val IDs exactly overlapping; R22 train453 has zero overlap; R25 detector best checkpoint was validation-selected; shape checkpoint has no embedded train list; OBB CSVs are frozen reused development predictions.
